definitions: To grow or cause to grow and become more mature, advanced, or elaborate.
To create something new or advanced.
To start to have a problem or illness.
To convert undeveloped photographic film or paper into a visible photographic image.
examples: The company plans to develop new software.
She developed a rash after eating the berries.
The photographer developed the film in the darkroom.
The city developed rapidly over the last decade.
